podcast.body: Featured on *Licensed to Ill*, this song's riff structure bears a strong similarity to AC/DC's "TNT," which was not accidental. The title itself was intentionally inspired by Motorhead's album *No Sleep till Hammer Smith*. Kerry King of Slayer contributed guitar work to this track. "And if you're a Motorhead fan, any similarity between the title of this song and Motorhead's No Sleep till Hammer Smith is purely intentional."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song intentionally features a riff structure similar to ACDC's "TNT." Its title is also a deliberate homage to Motorhead's "No Sleep 'til Hammersmith," making the similarities purely intentional. "The Beastie Boys and No Sleep till Brooklyn."
